_comment: Source of truth for the match data, transcribed from post-game screenshots.
Edit this file to add matches, then re-run `python load.py` (idempotent).
source_ref        - unique import key. Required. Prevents duplicate loads.
dota_match_id     - null when the screenshot did not show it.
played_at         - null when the time was not captured.
hero              - null on OVERVIEW-sourced rows; that tab shows art, not names.
Verification: for every match below, the sum of each team's player kills was
checked against the team score shown in the header. All match except match
8912219643 Dire (45 player kills vs 46 team score) -- see that match's notes.
_aliases_comment: Confirmed same-human identities. These are ASSERTED by the user from
personal knowledge of the group -- they are not inferred, and most of
them could not be inferred: 'cpx22' vs 'Mandark' and 'samundar khan'
vs 'rtz' share no name root at all.
`canonical` is the name every report displays. `alias` keeps its own row
and its raw observed data; only the reporting views resolve through it,
so nothing is rewritten or lost and any merge can be undone by deleting
a line here and re-running load.py.
load.py refuses a merge if the two names ever appeared in the SAME match,
since one person cannot occupy two slots in one game.
